tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /phag dkar shes rab gsal byed kyi nyams len bzhugs so// oṃ swasti/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /lan gsum/ rang skad cig gis rdo rje phag mor gsal ba'i thugs kar oṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥyig dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma dbu la bzhugs pa'i rje btsun rdo rje phag mo la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru bhyaḥ na mo bha ga ba tī badzra bā ra hī sa pa ri bā re bhyaḥ oṃ bha ga ba tī badzra bā ra hi sa pa ri bā ra arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gandhe/ nai bi dye shāpta pra tītstsha swāhā/ rnam dag lam bstan bdag nyid nges par 'bul/ /zab yangs chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /mya ngan mi 'da' yun ring bzhugs su gsol/ /bsod nams rdzogs pa'i byang chub chen por bsngo/ /lan gsum/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i bde ba rnams/ /de bzhin gshegs sku'i byin rlabs kyis/ /sems can rnams la 'grub par shog /tshar gcig oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ oṃ shu n+yā tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar am̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hrīḥyig dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad rje btsun ma'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus hrīḥyig rdo rje dang bcas pa la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje phag mo sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba/

zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas pas ba dan rtse gsum pas brgyan pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsnun pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing g.yon pa thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa mchan khung g.yon na rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pas brgyan pa'i kha ṭwāṃ ka bsnams pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing cung zad bzhad pa/ dbu skra nag po phyed bcings pa phyed grol ba la me tog sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pas mtshan pa'i mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcus do shal byas pa rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod dang ldan zhing / sgeg pa la sogs pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon bskum pa'i gar stabs kyis mi ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ sprul pa du ma 'phro bas sems can gyi don mdzad pa snang la rang bzhin med pa'i skur gyur pa'i snying khar padma dang nyi ma'i steng du rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hrīḥyig dkar po bsgoms la/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral bar g.yon du bskor zhing phaiṃ zhes dang / rang gi snying ga'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun rdo rje phag mo la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ bha ga ba ti nas pra tītstsha swāhā/ bar gong bzhin/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs rang la bstim/ oṃ yo ga shuddha sarba dharmā yo ga shuddho3haṃ/ zhes pas nga rgyal bzung / slar yang gong gi sngags rgyas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pā ri wā ra/ arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke gandhe/ nai wi dye/ shapta pra tītstsha swāhā/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang /

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing / bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇa pa ya gṛhṇa pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥn ya ho bha ga bān bidyā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shudho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas mtheb srin gyis blangs te 'bru gsum brjod cing myangs/ snying kha'i hrīḥlas 'od zer dkar po dpag tu med pa 'phros pas sems can thams cad rje btsun ma'i go 'phang la bkod nas tshur 'dus te rang la thim/ lte bar pad nyi la gnas pa'i hrīḥlas hrīḥyig gi phreng ba spros pa dbu ma nas brgyud de zhal nas 'thon sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi yon tan dang / khyad par mkhyen pa'i ye shes thams cad spyan drangs nas rang gi lte bar zhugs pas mi shes pa'i mun pa thams cad sbyangs te shes bya thams cad la thogs pa med pa'i blo gros rgyas par gyur/ phreng ba la grangs bzung la/ hrīḥkho na brgya stong sogs nus tshad bzlas la/ sdud pa na rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /shes rab gsal byed 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog/ //ces brjod/ 'di sa skya pa kun blo'i slob ma rgyang grub dbang sras mo chos dbyings 'od gsal rab byung ma'i don du bris// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ phag dkar shes rab gsal byed kyi nyams len/
